system.description:
When using Mask of a Thousand Faces, you can create a false impression of your disguise on recording media — having your picture taken, showing up on videotape, and even recording an imitation of the subject's voice. Nosferatu without this Merit cannot disguise themselves to machines using Obfuscate.

System: Spend a Mental Trait for each use of this Merit (beyond any expenditure for Mask of a Thousand Faces itself) — one Trait for your voice, one for your reflection, etc. Describe what the recording device picks up.
system.source: Clanbook: Nosferatu, Chapter One ("Legends and History"), "Merits and Flaws"
